# Optional audio assets

The game already includes the supplied gameplay audio under `src/imports/`:

- `BG.m4a` — looping gameplay music
- `BUILD_UP.m4a` — final 98% buildup
- `EXPLOSION.m4a` — final egg crack/break sound

Optional files can be added here later without changing the React code:

- `CLICK.m4a`
- `DAB.m4a`
- `TIMER_BEEP.m4a`

The app handles missing optional files gracefully.
